confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on several 2026-dated aggregated guides and index-style figures, so they are moderately reliable. Cocktail and wine_glass are weaker: the cocktail figure uses a small-sample Expatistan estimate and the wine glass uses one rooftop anecdote plus the local beer relationship, so treat them as bounded estimates. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context, not inspected live listings or current booking pages. The FX observation comes from a search snippet that cites the RBA exchange-rates overview page; I could not open rba.gov.au directly to confirm the 18 November 2026 figure.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced against lower-cost Central and Eastern European capitals with similar tourism demand and Baltic peers. Food and drink anchors use aggregated 2026 guide and index figures for Vilnius, with the lowest-confidence drink anchors bounded by the local beer-to-drink relationship. Accommodation uses general knowledge of Vilnius hostel and hotel tiers.
